variants.specifics: Brackenford: Ulric, an old shepherd at the edge of the Ashwood, wants the Wolves that took his sheep killed.

offer.speaker: Ulric
offer.text:
Help! Please, help me! A pack of grey Wolves just came down out of the Ashwood, behind my fold and dragged off nearly half of my sheep! One of them was my fine old ram, Barley!

Please put an end to those Wolves and you'll have a reward!

reminder.speaker: Ulric
reminder.text: Oh why are you still standing here? My flock gets smaller every night!

completion.speaker: Ulric
completion.text: Oh, bless you, brave Adventurer! Here, these are for you!

journal.text: Kill the Wolves raiding Ulric's flock at the edge of the Ashwood.

variants.specifics: Dolgar: Brunna, who keeps the mushroom farms, wants the leeches and bats driven out and her trapped pickers saved.

offer.speaker: Brunna
offer.text:
Where have you been all this time!? Something terrible has happened!

Monstrous leeches and shrieking bats from the Deep have swarmed the mushroom farms. Brave pickers have perished in the service of Dolgar's dinner tables!

Please, I implore you! Drive the vermin from the farms, save my pickers and I'll pay you generously.

This key opens the shed where my first picker is hiding. She knows where the rest of them are.

I also have a spell book that may come in handy.

reminder.speaker: Brunna
reminder.text: Come back once my pickers are safe and you'll have your pay.

completion.speaker: Brunna
completion.text:
You're a hero through and through! I can't thank you enough.

While you were down in the farms, chasing off those leeches, Haskel stopped in, asking after you. He'll meet you at the Great Lift -- west of here.

But first, please take this gold for your trouble.

journal.text: Kill or charm every beast in the mushroom farms. Save the 4 pickers trapped there.

variants.writer: Claude Agent SDK subagent, Claude Opus 5.5

variants.specifics: Pellmire: Gummet, an old walkway-dweller, wants the Leech nest under the Rotten Pilings burned out.

offer.speaker: Gummet
offer.text:
Blast it! Where were you, lad!? The Leeches swarmed up out of the water onto the lower walkways and we'd have lost every one of them if Mayor Dobbet's torchmen were not rushed down the ladders at the very last!

But in all the commotion, the slimy things laid a nest under the pilings, leaving the walkways our smallest worry! All Pellmire is in danger if that nest hatches!

You must go where the Leeches crawled off to, south to the Rotten Pilings! Burn out that nest or we are finished!

reminder.speaker: Gummet
reminder.text: I just know that nest is about to hatch! Hurry!

completion.speaker: Gummet
completion.text:
In happier days, the whole of Pellmire would turn out to celebrate the end of those Leeches! Fine work! But now we must deal with Mogrut and his Ogres once and for all.

Take these as a small thanks from all of us for a brave deed!

journal.text: Go to the Rotten Pilings and destroy the Leech nest.

variants.specifics: Korlen: Hobb the bell-ringer: an Ogre beat his two bell boys and ran off with the clapper of the great bell.

offer.speaker: Hobb
offer.text: Ooooh, how could this happen? That Ogre beat both of my bell boys black and blue. There's no time to fetch the guard. Hurry, you must catch him before the clapper of the great bell is gone for good.

reminder.speaker: Hobb
reminder.text: Please, I'm begging you. Run down that thieving brute and bring back my clapper.

completion.speaker: Hobb
completion.text: The clapper is saved! Commander Dorvik will need it to ring the alarm on the walls. Here, take my Bow and bring the clapper to him.

journal.text: Recover the bell's clapper stolen by the Ogre thief.

variants.specifics: Ondel: Warden Tobb posts a bounty on the outlaw Jory Blackgill and his crew of net cutters.

offer.speaker: Tobb
offer.text:
Greetings, Wanderer. I presume you have come about the bounty.

There's a fat reward for Jory Blackgill -- dead or alive. He and his rotten crew of net cutters have been robbing our village all season.

Watch yourself, those slimy cutthroats will stab you in the back.

reminder.speaker: Tobb
reminder.text: What are you waiting for? Blackgill is still out there!

completion.speaker: Tobb
completion.text:
Hallo there! Fennick heard a terrible racket out this way, so I came running to have a look.

You have caught the infamous Jory Blackgill all by your lonesome! Most remarkable! You have earned my highest regard! Blackgill's crew has plagued Ondel all season! I'll handle things from here. We will all sleep easier with this low-down villain locked in my cellar!

And here is the bounty -- 150 in gold!

journal.text: Hunt down the outlaw Jory Blackgill.

variants.specifics: Ostrel: Archivist Umbrik has shut himself in a closet while bats roost in his reading room at the Archive.

offer.speaker: Umbrik
offer.text:
These filthy bats are a curse on my house! My students tried to smoke them out, but back they come every night! You are my last hope of getting the vermin out!

The bats are up in my reading room, there, at the top of the stairs. Please, watch yourself.

reminder.speaker: Umbrik
reminder.text: I won't come out of this closet till those bats are gone! Swat them, burn them, I don't care how! Just get rid of them! Hurry before more of them roost!

completion.speaker: Umbrik
completion.text:
Brave Adventurer, you have my heartfelt thanks! You have earned the friendship of the College. The porters will be told that you may enter the Archive whenever you like.

Here is some gold for your pains. I must insist.

journal.text: Drive the bats out of Archivist Umbrik's reading room.

variants.specifics: Fort Skarra: Grubb, sentry at the frozen rope lift, wants back the fur cap the Imps of the Imp caves stole while he napped on watch.

offer.speaker: Grubb
offer.text:
Sorry, pal, the rope lift is frozen stiff! Only way down to the lower pass is the long way, through the Imp caves. But, if you go that way, keep your eyes open! Those Imps swiped my fur cap while I was napping on watch!

If you get it back for me, pal, I'll show you a mighty handy spell.

reminder.speaker: Grubb
reminder.text: Any sign of my cap? My ears are turning blue!

completion.speaker: Grubb
completion.text: My cap! I figured it was gone for good! I owe you one, pal. Here's that Spell, like I said.

journal.text: Recover the fur cap the Imps stole from Grubb and return it.

variants.specifics: Vurn: Grenna's coal cellar is overrun by Rats and her pig Gubbin is shut in with them.

offer.speaker: Grenna
offer.text:
Oh please, kind sir, help me! The Rats have overrun my coal cellar and my poor pig, Gubbin, is shut in down there with them!

Get rid of them and fetch him out and I'll owe you my life!

reminder.speaker: Grenna
reminder.text: Whatever you find down in the cellar is yours! Just hurry and save Gubbin!

completion.speaker: Grenna
completion.text:
Oh, thank heavens, you've got him! How will I ever pay you back for such courage?!

What's that, now? Heaps and heaps of gold? Well, if that's your price, here, accept this as a token of my appreciation.

journal.text: Save Gubbin the Pig from a Rat-infested cellar in Vurn.

variants.specifics: Varrow: Hobbin the shepherd has lost sheep and his dog to the wolves of the Grimwood and wants their den cleared.

offer.speaker: Hobbin
offer.text:
Snarling, filthy brutes! The wolves only just came out of the Grimwood and already they've eaten a good part of my flock!

I am Hobbin the shepherd. I am searching for my old dog. I'm afraid the wolves have carried him off to their den in the wood.

Should you find my dog and chase off those wolves, I would pay you handsomely. Come along, I'll lead you to the trail into that miserable den beyond my fields.

reminder.speaker: Hobbin
reminder.text: Did you find my dog yet? Oh no, I just know he's been eaten.

completion.speaker: Hobbin
completion.text:
My dog's collar! Something dreadful must have happened to him.

You have shown those wolves who's master in these hills. Maybe you would make a fine shepherd yourself. Hmmm... Maybe.

Come along to my hut. When you are ready, just take my old bow and arrows down from the wall and they are yours. I have a whole flock to build up again.

journal.text: Find out what became of Hobbin's dog.

variants.specifics: Tolm: Brunn, a pig farmer, has lost his pigs to Bears and wants them hunted down.

offer.speaker: Brunn
offer.text:
Truth be told, my farm's been doing rather poorly of late. Ten nights back, Bears broke into the sty and dragged off my pigs.

I don't suppose I'll ever get my pigs back, but I'd like nothing better than to see those Bears hunted down.

I'll gladly pay whoever puts an end to them.

reminder.speaker: Brunn
reminder.text: Any luck with those Bears? They had another pig last night!

completion.speaker: Brunn
completion.text:
So those Bears are finished! Good work, lad! My pigs can rest easy knowing those brutes won't be shoving their big hairy snouts in my sty!

And here's what I promised... 90 gold pieces! You're welcome at my farm anytime!

journal.text: Hunt down the Bears that have been stealing Brunn's pigs.
